model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2" across different layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and employs a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2. The plot displays three lines, none of which feature distinct marker shapes. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," begins at approximately 0.2 at Layer 0, drops sharply to near 0.0 by Layer 2, and maintains a steady, flat trend near 0.0 through the end of the x-axis at Layer 23. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," starts at 1.0 at Layer 0, exhibits a steady decline to roughly 0.15 near Layer 15, and then shows fluctuations, including a peak near 0.4 at Layer 21, before ending at approximately 0.4 at Layer 23. The green dash-dot line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," also starts at 1.0 at Layer 0, declines steadily to approximately 0.1 by Layer 12, and remains relatively stable near this value for the remainder of the plot, ending near 0.1 at Layer 23.
